integrity: Self-contained original computation and write-up; no independent mathematical verification, no claims of exhaustive priority or of authorial identity. The finite verifier includes a complete directed Hasse acyclicity test and exact integer cocycle evaluations.
scientific_limitations: The 30-vertex intrinsic graph metric only; no Euclidean-chordal, arbitrary Archimedean, equivariant, or independent validation claims. Distinct scale-two/scale-three sphere stages are linked by an integral degree-one homology map; no relative simplicial collapse is claimed. Publication priority against unindexed sources is unresolved.
title: Complete integral graph-metric Rips persistence of the icosidodecahedron
